page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-8 is an arm64-based virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The arm64 architecture of the n4a-highmem-8 provides a high-density hardware profile. This architecture typically offers qualitative cost-efficiency advantages for memory-intensive workloads compared to traditional x86 alternatives, allowing for efficient resource utilization without the overhead of unneeded local storage or GPU accelerators.

Given the 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU and the dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is designed for memory-intensive tasks that do not require local NVMe storage or graphics acceleration. Suitable workloads include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching systems, data buffering, and general-purpose applications requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute resources.
